title: Isaiah 56
paragraphs: ¹ This is what the LORD says: "Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is close at hand and my righteousness will soon be revealed. ² Blessed is the man who does this — the person who holds fast to it — who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it and keeps his hand from doing any evil. ³ Let no foreigner who has bound himself to the LORD say, 'The LORD will surely exclude me from his people.' And let no eunuch complain, 'I am nothing but a dry tree.' ⁴ For this is what the LORD says: 'To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant — ⁵ to them I will give within my temple and its walls a memorial and a name better than sons and daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will endure forever.'

⁶ "And foreigners who bind themselves to the LORD to serve him, to love the name of the LORD and to be his servants — all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it and who hold fast to my covenant — ⁷ these I will bring to my holy mountain and give them joy in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations." ⁸ The Lord GOD declares — he who gathers the exiles of Israel: "I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered." ⁹ Come, all you beasts of the field, come and devour, all you animals of the forest! ¹⁰ Israel's watchmen are blind — they are all ignorant, all of them are like mute dogs that cannot bark. They lie around dreaming, lying down, loving to sleep.

¹¹ These are greedy dogs that never have enough; they are shepherds with no understanding. They all look to their own way, each one out for his own gain. ¹² "Come," they say, "let me get some wine; let us drink our fill of beer! And tomorrow will be like today — only far better!"
